text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's Manhattan Cafe! She's crept up to
the front,
and she's finished in first!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: WHOOOAAAA...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: She ran so naturally it was practically... supernatural! The crowd is baffled at this turn of events!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was a firm finish the likes of which
I've
never
seen from her before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The daily grind that took us through
spring and
summer has finally borne
fruit.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer! My friend... My friend!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
She was...
right in front of me! I've never
gotten
so close to her in a race before!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I didn't get that close. But...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I was almost there. And even after running today's race, I feel totally fine...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Is this... me? This...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She whispers, as if she can't believe it.
Hearing
her is all the proof I need.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The paranormal phenomena that racked
her body
for so long are finally gone.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, hahaha! Yes, this is good. This
is it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Everything is in line with my predictions!
It's like
getting the perfect amount every
time I open a
burette valve!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Don't you think so, Cafe?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: This doesn't mean I trusted you.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: But it's as you say... I'm glad I didn't push myself too hard in the spring. You can be self-centered, but...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Somewhere in there, you were thinking
of me,
too... That's what I felt today.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, is it safe to take that as an
expression of
gratitude?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, either way. What say we keep this
up?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, this is where we accelerate! Faster and faster!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Relishing in our victory, we return to my
office
and get to work on our next plan.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Honestly... I don't think there's anything
wrong
with my body. Now that I've
managed to run all
3,000 meters...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I think I can make it... through the
autumn races,
and the winter ones...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, well. You sure have toughened up,
haven't
you, Cafe?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What will you do, Trainer? The Kikuka
Sho and
the Classics are both over, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
How about this? Why not take on the
best of the senior-year racers? The
Japan Cup would be your
earliest shot at
that...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hm, and what's behind that decision?
choice_data_list: No, let's aim for the Arima Kinen ...
No, let's aim for the Arima Kinen ...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: Because I want you to rest, even i...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not just that I want her to rest.
After seeing
today's race, I'm starting to think
that a slightly
longer race would be best.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup is 2,400 meters, while
the Arima Kinen is 2,500. It's only a
hundred-meter gap,
but it could make
all the difference.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oho, a very nice idea! Those are the
eyes of a strategist. Looks like my
intellect might just be
rubbing off on
you.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
All right... The Arima Kinen... I'm not
sure who my
competition will be,
though.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
That's where I'll catch up to my friend.
And we
should be able to end this year
by realizing our
dream...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Your friend, you say... Chasing your
dreams is
good and all, but the Arima
Kinen is no run in the
park.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You'll be competing against runners at
the top of
their game. It's almost like...
they're different
lifeforms altogether...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And this is the Arima Kinen we're talking
about... I
expect those two will be
making an appearance.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The two seniors currently ranked
highest. They're
snapping up first and
second position in every
race.
Ah! Aah!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Aaaah! Ha ha haaa!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeek! Opera O, wh-what was that just
now?
Were you about to sneeze?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Why, my ears are burning. Someone
must be
gossiping about us.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I thought it a fan singing my praises, but

apparently not. I'm sensing something
ominous
about.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eep? When you say "ominous"...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series! One who lurks
beneath the
dazzling theater stage on
which we dance.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: An unknowable phantom has appeared... One seeking to upend our performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that Manhattan Cafe is on a
trajectory to
the Arima Kinen, new rivals
await her.
